KNOWLEDGE_NAME_TAKEN: A knowledge base with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
KNOWLEDGE_BASE_DELETED: Restore the knowledge base first, then restore this source.
KNOWLEDGE_NO_EMBEDDING_MODEL: Choose an embedding model before adding documents.
KNOWLEDGE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_INVALID: This model can't be used for embeddings. Choose an enabled embedding model.
KNOWLEDGE_LOCAL_EMBEDDING_REQUIRED: A knowledge base limited to local models needs a local embedding model.
KNOWLEDGE_REEMBED_IN_PROGRESS: This knowledge base is being re-indexed. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE_STATE_INVALID: That action doesn't apply to this source right now.
KNOWLEDGE_DUPLICATE_FILE: This file is already in this knowledge base.
KNOWLEDGE_FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than the limit. Split it into smaller files.
KNOWLEDGE_FILE_UNSUPPORTED: This file type isn't supported. Check the supported types and try another file.
KNOWLEDGE_UPLOAD_CORRUPTED: The file changed during upload. Add it again.
KNOWLEDGE_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Processing this source took too long. Try again, or upload a smaller file.
KNOWLEDGE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Couldn't download this page or file. Check that it is still available and try again.
KNOWLEDGE_LINK_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach this link. Check the address and try again.
KNOWLEDGE_CONNECTION_EXPIRED: The connection expired. Reconnect to keep syncing; existing passages stay searchable.
KNOWLEDGE_REEMBED_FAILED: Couldn't re-index this document with the new model. Try again.
